name: Yamanobe Homura
source:
He's the son of the archaeologist who investigates the mansion.

PET bottles: he can reduce the fear bar 3 times. You can refill them with water.

Fears: nothing.

[spoiler]He changes to Ayakouji Homura in Yuki's route.[/spoiler]

Family: father (Yamanobe, university professor); mother (deceased).
